mapper.select: SELECT member_id, email, password, name, age, profile_id, created_at FROM `member` WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT member_id, email, password, name, age, profile_id, created_at FROM `member` WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `member` WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `member` (email, password, name, age, profile_id) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{age}, #{profileId})
mapper.update: UPDATE `member` SET name = #{name}, age = #{age}, profile_id = #{profileId}, password = #{password}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE `member` SET email = CONCAT('withdrawn-', member_id, '-', UNIX_TIMESTAMP(), '@deleted.local'), deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
